name: refund_customer
description: Refund money to a customer for one of their orders. This moves money: only call it when the customer explicitly asks for a refund and has given the order ID, the amount and a reason. When an order's refunds reach 500 USD or more, the refund returns status PENDING_APPROVAL: it waits for a review by the support team and is not refunded yet. If the call is denied by policy, report that to the customer.

customer_id.description: Customer ID in the form CUST- followed by digits, e.g. CUST-1001.

order_id.description: Numeric order ID that belongs to the customer, e.g. 123.

amount.description: Refund amount in USD as a number with at most two decimals, e.g. 25.5.

amount_cents.description: Set automatically from amount by the agent. Leave empty.

reason.description: Short reason for the refund, in the customer's words.

idempotency_key.description: Set automatically by the agent. Any value is fine; it is replaced.
